title: LADA Blue Wings vs Night Owls, Nov 15
notes: Renton's re-aimed camera (rink renton2nov), rolled about a degree as on Turbo Kings' game later that night; the same geometry held. Periods come from the board's clock, each to 0.0; the video starts at the 1st's opening faceoff. The 3rd's start is 2374, a second later than the clock reader's, where the board leaves 18:00. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd, and the board was dark for stretches of the 3rd.

Played: 10 skaters, with sub goalie Pfeifer #0 (red). Babkin #26 played all game, though LADA's lineup leaves him out. Tverskoy #44 is on LADA's lineup but not the game sheet; OCR never read 44 and he has no row on any period's roster card, so he isn't counted. Didn't play: Potepalov #15, Trunov #35, Tverskoy #44, Dukhno #50, Gareev #53, Shipachev #88, Antonov #95 and the subs.

Goal times come from the video, each to the second the puck went in; the credits are the game sheet's. Ilinskaya's 5-2 (3rd period) came out of a pile-up at the crease at 51:49 of the video, where the puck can't be seen. The board's clock stood at 8:48 at that whistle, then ran 6 s while the board was dark, so the sheet's 8:42 is the board's later reading; the board posted the goal about 4 minutes late. Night Owls' 4-2 fell in a dark stretch of the board; the frames put it at 46:24. Their 4-1 came 40 s after our 4-0, straight off the center faceoff.
No penalties for us. Night Owls' Choi #98 took a roughing minor in the 2nd.

Lineups were checked by eye: 28 on/off spans fix line changes the tracker missed, among them Babkin #26 on the ice for his own goal (the solver had him on the bench) and Charnysh #36, whose tracks carried #3 and #26 for a shift in the 1st.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 9:24: poked past the downed goalie in a scramble at their crease, 1-0
1st period, clock 4:36: Horokh shoots from the right side, 2-0
2nd period, clock 12:55: Semenov jams it in at the downed goalie, 3-0
2nd period, clock 8:19: Babkin in alone, cuts across the crease and beats the sprawling goalie, 4-0
2nd period, clock 7:38: straight off the center faceoff, their #19 goes in alone and slides it in, 4-1
3rd period, clock 13:21: jammed in at our crease after a faceoff in our zone, 4-2
3rd period, clock 8:42: in from a pile-up at their crease, 5-2
